question: Does bounded per-dragon terrain memory help, and does known-pair portal routing add value?
selection: After judge-runtime preflight, screen both candidates and control against v2. Highest new score above .5 advances unchanged; ties prefer terrain_memory. No winner means stop. Screen is 216 games; selected validation is 864 games.
gate: Fresh-seed validation direct v2 map-cluster CI lower > .5 AND paired pool gain map-cluster CI lower > 0, plus exact replay and judge-budget checks. Novel-map confirmation needed before promotion if validation passes.
limits: 96 expanded nodes, 12 steps; food sightings expire after 8 rounds. Static terrain persists. No shared memory or sonar. Unknown occupancy is uncertain. No unpaired portal traversal; no emergency portal fallback combination.
